description: An opaque dark green woven gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and gold-toned knotwork borders along the neckline, sleeves, waist, and long skirt panels. A cream underdress is visible down the center and below the hem. A green checked fringed wrap drapes from round shoulder brooches along the arms, and a woven belt closes with a round clasp. Brown shoes are visible below the floor-length skirt.
